skill.name: kleros-ipfs-upload
skill.description: Upload Kleros case artifacts to IPFS through an x402 USDC payment gateway on Base mainnet. Supports evidence, meta-evidence, policy, and justification uploads that return IPFS CIDs and gateway URLs.
skill.summary: Paid Kleros IPFS uploads with x402 payment support on Base mainnet.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown, TypeScript template literals, documented URLs, and normal credential configuration. Material risks remain: payment terms are not locally pinned or verified, dependencies are installed unpinned before secret use, and instructions restrict necessary inspection. Credential-file path selection and diagnostic wallet metadata need safeguards.

remediation.issue: Payment challenge terms are not constrained.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist the gateway and validate payee, Base network, USDC contract, and maximum amount before authorizing a payment.

remediation.issue: Dependencies are installed without a committed lockfile.
remediation.suggestion: Commit a lockfile, use npm ci, pin versions, and document package integrity review before credentials are used.
Require an explicit approved path, reject symlinks and unexpected locations, and load only required variables.
Make balance and address logging opt-in and redact sensitive operational values by default.
Remove the instruction that forbids inspection outside the package and require review of dependencies and payment terms.

content.value_statement: Kleros case files need durable IPFS references, but payment-enabled upload flows require careful wallet handling. This skill guides Kleros-specific uploads and returns CIDs for evidence and contract-linked artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Uploads Kleros-related files through the documented x402 gateway.
Supports evidence, meta-evidence, policy, and justification operation labels.
Uses an EVM signer or Coinbase CDP account for x402 payment signing.
Returns IPFS CIDs and gateway URLs from successful upload responses.
Provides pre-flight checks for gateway health and payment discovery.
limitations: Each paid upload uses USDC on Base mainnet and needs explicit wallet authorization.
The bundled scripts do not enforce a payment recipient, amount, token, or network allowlist.
The service is limited to Kleros-related uploads and gateway availability.
IPFS persistence and returned URLs depend on external gateway and pinning services.

use_cases.title: Attach dispute evidence
use_cases.description: Upload a screenshot or document and record its CID for a Kleros dispute.

use_cases.title: Publish meta-evidence
use_cases.description: Upload meta-evidence JSON for a court or arbitrator contract reference.

use_cases.title: Store juror justification
use_cases.description: Publish a justification artifact and retain its IPFS reference for later review.

prompt_templates.title: Upload one evidence file
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload my Kleros evidence file at ./evidence.pdf. Show payment terms first and ask for confirmation before any paid request.

prompt_templates.title: Publish meta-evidence JSON
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./meta-evidence.json with operation meta-evidence. Verify file size, show gateway payment details, then return the CID.

prompt_templates.title: Use a CDP account
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my configured CDP account to upload ./policy.json as policy. Do not print secrets. Confirm network, payee, token, and amount before signing.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an upload result
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this Kleros IPFS CID through the documented gateway. Report whether returned CID and URL are consistent without making a paid upload.

output: Gateway response returned one CID and one URL.
Save the CID before submitting the contract transaction.

best_practices: Use a dedicated wallet with a small USDC balance for paid uploads.
Verify gateway, payee, network, token, and amount before each payment authorization.
Keep local copies and record returned CIDs in case documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not use a wallet with unrelated funds or broad permissions.
Do not trust a returned URL or CID without checking its response and content.
Do not pass secret values in chat, command history, or shared logs.

faq.question: Does this upload cost money?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented flow uses USDC on Base mainnet and requires confirmation before payment.

faq.question: What files should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use Kleros evidence, meta-evidence, policies, Curate metadata, and related justification artifacts.

faq.question: Which payment methods work?
faq.answer: The bundled flows support an EVM private key signer or Coinbase CDP server credentials.

faq.question: What does a successful upload return?
faq.answer: The gateway returns IPFS CIDs and may return ready-to-use HTTP URLs.

faq.question: Can I use another IPFS provider?
faq.answer: This skill targets its documented Kleros gateway. Use a general IPFS service for unrelated uploads.

faq.question: Should I use my main wallet?
faq.answer: No. Use a dedicated wallet with only the funds needed for expected upload payments.
